facts.fact: Rema's assize is still sitting on the morning of ch 25; Devan leaves mid-session and Rema has the court note his absence.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the court to note Devan's absence

facts.fact: Neela put off the first reading of the forty's pages until after the assize; Devan asked once, on the ridge road, that she read them sooner, and she gave a good reason.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the delay she called protection to hand Chathu the forty back, and Devan's restraint to read as not saying he warned her

facts.fact: Bhaskaran and eight Kettamala spearmen ride with Neela and Devan to the Resin House; Pavi and Vasu's six are outside the wall in the lee of the tapping sheds.
facts.why: needed for the gate scene's odds

facts.fact: Chathu holds the nightbark groves and threatens to burn them with a torch at the nearest grove and a fire in the oil store; the forty's pages are in Neela's saddlebag with the ledger.
In human form Vellan walks with a hitch on the left leg, a drag and a step, matching his bear-shape drag.
facts.why: needed to show his old wound from the raid carried into human form
